trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release with a healthy production history — in all regions. The rollback was verified and all regions are now healthy.
- **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback, and the need to root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before re-release. The on-call engineer has been paged.
